text.title: GovTech FOIA / Records-Retention BA Pack Failure Modes
text.summary: 6 known failure modes when producing a GovTech FOIA / records-retention BA pack. Each carries a detector (what to look for) and a repair (the corrective action) keyed to a rule in 01-core-rules.xml.

failure-mode.description: No retention schedule; the system keeps every record indefinitely, or a background job deletes by age with no schedule authority.
failure-mode.detector: Record classes in the data model with no retention period or disposition, or a delete job whose period cites no schedule item.
failure-mode.repair: Map every record class to a schedule item, period and disposition per r-retention-schedule-per-record-class; get the records officer's signature before the delete job ships.

failure-mode.description: A store (queue, blob bucket, vendor SaaS) holds responsive records but has no way to search and produce them inside the statutory clock.
failure-mode.detector: Any store in the inventory whose export path is blank, "ask engineering", or requires custom code with no owner.
failure-mode.repair: Build or procure the export path before launch per r-request-export-within-statutory-clock; if impossible, remove the store from the design or stop it holding records.

failure-mode.description: Exempt content lives in free-text columns; every request becomes a manual read-and-redact exercise and a name is missed.
failure-mode.detector: Citizen PII or law-enforcement detail stored in an untagged notes or description field; no exemption map in the pack.
failure-mode.repair: Tag exempt fields at schema level and split mixed free text per r-exempt-fields-tagged-in-schema; estimate manual-review cost for what cannot be split and put it in the pack summary.

failure-mode.description: Case decisions are made in a chat tool with auto-delete; the records exist nowhere the agency can search.
failure-mode.detector: A staff communication channel in use for the system that is absent from the channel inventory or has no capture mechanism.
failure-mode.repair: Add the channel, wire capture to the system of record, disable auto-delete for official business per r-ephemeral-channels-captured.

failure-mode.description: The audit plan says "post-launch accessibility review"; the first screen-reader user files a complaint the week of go-live.
failure-mode.detector: Audit plan without per-flow manual assistive-technology tests, or launch checklist without a no-critical-failure gate and accessibility statement.
failure-mode.repair: Rewrite the plan to WCAG 2.1 AA (or 2.2 AA) with per-flow tests and a launch gate per r-wcag-aa-audit-gates-launch; move launch if criticals remain.

failure-mode.description: Launch date is set without the public-notice or PRA clearance window; the intake form cannot legally collect on the planned date.
failure-mode.detector: Pack says "PRA: not assessed", or a new public form with no OMB control number and fewer than 90 days plus review time before launch.
failure-mode.repair: Assess applicability, file the 60-day and 30-day notices, and re-baseline the launch per r-public-notice-buffer-scheduled.
